XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Right front and left rear wheels remain braked
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ABS | GROUP | ANTI | LOCK | SYSTEM | REMAINS | BRAKING | BRAKED | LEFT | LEFT | RIGHT | RIGHT | TYRE | WHEEL | REMAIN | BRAKED | BRAKED |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: ABS

  • Device: ABS hydraulic unit

  • Fault: The vehicle’s front right and rear left wheels remain constantly under braking, causing the vehicle to struggle to move

  • Errors detected by the on-board diagnostics: C10A3

  • Cause: Faulty ABS unit

• Action: Check that the ABS hydraulic unit is functioning correctly and, if necessary, repair or replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the fault was permanently resolved following the repair of the ABS hydraulic unit.
    The component is located in the engine compartment, on the passenger side between the engine and the passenger compartment.
